title: Roll and Stop
hook: An empty aisle. Nothing in it but you.
scene: The engine is on. Both cats are on the seat. The aisle ahead is empty, painted stalls on both sides, wet. You have room to roll and room to stop. There is no one to beat and no one to wait for.
decision: How do you move through the aisle?

options.text: Give it throttle and brake at the end
options.result: You go harder than the aisle needs. The stop is late and heavy. Both cats slide. You arrived. You did not stop where you meant.

options.text: Roll, ease off, and stop on the line you picked
options.result: You roll. You ease off before the stop. The car settles on the line you picked. The cats do not slide. That is the whole skill, and the lot is big enough to learn it.

options.text: Creep the whole aisle with the brake half on
options.result: You ride the brake the length of the aisle. The car never settles into a roll. You stop, but you never drove the space. You fought it.

options.text: Look at the cats and let the car find the end
options.result: You watch the seat instead of the aisle. The end arrives before you have chosen a stop. You brake because the stall paint is suddenly close.

debrief: Roll, ease off, stop where you meant. The lot is the place that still lets you practice that without a street attached.

source.psdp_skill: Skill two: moving, steering, and stopping
source.teaching_target: Start, roll, and stop on a line she picked. Smooth. The cats do not slide.
